name: F.E.A.R. Extraction Point
description: F.E.A.R. Extraction Point is a singleplayer first-person shooter and horror expansion in the F.E.A.R. series.

steam.patches: The English version loses some radio voices when hardware sound is on, and the unofficial 'F.E.A.R. Extraction Point EAX Fix' brings them back (per PCGamingWiki).

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX effects
audio_settings.reason: F.E.A.R. Extraction Point ships with its hardware sound and EAX options off, so it plays with no EAX reverb.
